appDescription: A vehicle app that coordinates a private pickup with a contact and a passenger-selected pickup point.

function.name: START_PICKUP
function.description: Starts a pickup for a contact chosen by the driver.

contactName.description: The name of the contact to pick up.

pickupTime.description: The requested pickup time, if the driver said one.

function.name: CHOOSE_PICKUP_CONTACT
function.description: Chooses one of multiple matching contacts after the app asks for clarification.

choiceIndex.description: The one-based number of the matching contact chosen by the driver.

function.name: START_VOICE_REPLY
function.description: Start a hands-free voice reply to the passenger in the current pickup. The app will ask for the message and confirm it before sending.
